claims: Lucas Oil Stadium is located in downtown Indianapolis, Indiana.
Lucas Oil Stadium is located at 500 South Capitol Avenue.
Lucas Oil Stadium serves as the home field for the NFL's Indianapolis Colts.
Lucas Oil Stadium's address is 500 South Capitol Ave, Indianapolis, IN 46225.
Lucas Oil Stadium has a capacity of over 63,000 for football.
Lucas Oil Stadium's capacity is expandable to 70,000.
Lucas Oil Stadium has a retractable roof.
Lucas Oil Stadium has a large window with views of the city skyline.
Lucas Oil Stadium is situated in the heart of Indianapolis's sports district.
